class.name: VASourceLeech
class.description: A sound source that leeches raytracing results off a parent [VAEmitter] instead of casting its own rays. Must be a direct child of a [VAEmitter] (or [VAListener]) node. Useful for sounds that fire frequently from the same location (e.g. footsteps, gunshots) without each needing its own raytraced emitter. [method play] returns [code]false[/code] until the parent emitter is ready to play (see [method is_ready_to_play]). If [member ALSource.autoplay] is [code]true[/code], playback starts automatically once it's ready. The world bounds rules of [VASource] apply, using the parent emitter's position and [member VAEmitter.clamp_position] (see [method is_silenced_by_bounds]). It counts as looping if [member ALSource.looping] is on.

method.name: is_ready_to_play
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the parent emitter can play. See [method VAEmitter.is_ready_to_play].

method.name: is_silenced_by_bounds
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the parent emitter is silenced by the world bounds. See [method VAEmitter.is_silenced_by_bounds].
